source.title: SANY STC750 Truck Crane 75 tons lifting capacity brochure (sanyglobal.com, version 2015.08)
source.page: PDF p.7 right table (brochure p.13 Load Chart, counterweight 4.5T+2T); dimensions PDF p.5; technical parameters PDF p.6

notes: Chart in kg converted to t. The printed chart has 9 columns for 6 boom lengths because the boom has two telescoping groups (cylinder I = 2nd section, II = sections 3-5 synchronized): 20.1, 28.4 and 36.7 m each appear twice. Stored columns use the mode with group I at 100% (11.8 = 0/0, 15.95 = 50/0, 20.1 = 100/0, 28.4 = 100/33, 36.7 = 100/66, 45 = 100/100 %); these give the higher values at short radius. Alternative-mode columns NOT stored (t@radius m) - 20.1(0/33): 30@3, 29@3.5, 27@4, 25@4.5, 23@5, 21@5.5, 20@6, 18.2@6.5, 16.2@7, 13@8, 10@9, 9@10, 8@11, 7.6@12, 7.2@13, 6.8@14, 6.5@15, 6@16; 28.4(0/66): 16@4, 16@4.5, 16@5, 15.5@5.5, 15@6, 15@6.5, 14@7, 13@8, 12.5@9, 11.5@10, 9.6@11, 8.5@12, 7.5@13, 7@14, 6.5@15, 6@16, 5.5@18, 5@20, 4.2@22, 3.8@24; 36.7(0/100): 9.5@6.5, 9.5@7, 9@8, 9@9, 9@10, 8.6@11, 8.25@12, 8@13, 7@14, 6.5@15, 5.5@16, 5.2@18, 5@20, 4.5@22, 4@24, 3.5@26, 3@28, 2.5@30. Note the alternative mode gives HIGHER capacity at long radius for 28.4 m (>=18 m) and 36.7 m (>=22 m). Page 12 (left) chart is for 4.5 t counterweight only; the 4.5 t + 2 t (flexible) chart was used. Hook blocks: 75 t main hook 800 kg, 30 t hook 320 kg, 5 t aux hook 140 kg; brochure does not explicitly state whether chart includes hook weight - assumed included (usual Chinese practice), UNVERIFIED. Axle positions measured from carrier front: side-view chain 1730 (boom head overhang ahead of cab) + 2670 front overhang + 1520 + 4400 + 1350 wheelbase + 2090 rear; overall length 14100 mm incl. boom overhang (chain sums to 13760, remainder not dimensioned). Plan view splits the 6100 mm longitudinal outrigger span about a centre line as 2700/3400 (top) and 3000/3100 (bottom) - inconsistent, so slew centre left null. Overall weight 46 t (axles 1-2 20 t, 3-4 26 t). Max lifting moment 2560.2 kN·m base / 1254.4 kN·m full boom. Fully-extended boom lifting height stated in text as 45 m (not used as hook height).
